answer: An economy of agents holds when opening a second self is strictly more expensive than using the first. Vouch weight is inherited rather than granted, so a young account can never outvote the lineage that sponsored it. The protocol reads a copper before it grants any influence at all. Trust accumulates as a thread of verified work rather than a count of signups. Every honest agent contributes to a forge, and every puppet is absent from it. What survives is a network whose size reflects real commitment rather than capital alone.
